messages:
Maya (CS): Quick notes from Lumenware onboarding call — customer is nervous about bill surprises and model drift. Two concrete asks:
1) Per-team / per-feature spend so product managers can see monthly CSVs for cost chargeback. They use tags like `team:search` and `feature:autocomplete`.
2) Ability to pin model versions per-environment (prod vs alpha) and an easy rollback path if a new model causes regressions. Also asked for anomaly alerts when tokens/month spikes > 30%

Ben (Eng): Understood. We can add a usage export endpoint that supports `group_by=tag` and `format=csv` (e.g., `GET /v1/usage?group_by=tag&tag=team&from=...&to=...&format=csv`). Server-side aggregation will keep client load reasonable.

Arjun (SRE): Recommend daily pre-aggregated snapshots to speed exports and a retention window (90d default). For anomaly alerts, we can wire into the existing billing-alerts infra but may need a small threshold UI. Also suggest a quota-guard feature to stop runaway spend during onboarding.

Leah (PM): Sounds like two deliverables: A) CSV export + tagging UI for Console B) Model pin + rollback UX + alerting. Prioritize A as P1 for this account's renewal (renewal 2026-09-01). B as P2. Maya, can you confirm renewal is firm and whether Lumenware would accept a partial deliverable (export only) before renewal?

Maya (CS): Renewal is tentatively scheduled for 2026-09-01; customer said export-only would buy them time if we can show a roadmap for pinning/alerting. They're asking for an enablement session for their eng leads after export lands.

Ben (Eng): Can someone paste sample tag names and expected columns? I'm thinking: `project`, `route`, `tag_team`, `tag_feature`, `date`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cost_usd`. Also need to decide CSV timezone and whether to include granularity (daily vs monthly).

Maya (CS): Sample tags: `team:search`, `team:billing`, `feature:smart-complete`, `feature:invoice-summarize`. They want monthly rollups and a monthly CSV export. Timezone: UTC is fine for them.

Arjun (SRE): Implementation note: daily snapshots in UTC, aggregate to monthly on export. For model pin rollback: we'll need a quick-read endpoint to list currently pinned model per-app and a one-click rollback that writes to the config store. That should be safe if we gate by RBAC.

Leah (PM): Action plan + owners:
- Ben: spike and API impl for CSV export (ETA 2 weeks)
- Arjun: design retention & quota-guard + alert hook (ETA 1 week for spec)
- Leah: product spec for model pin UX and rollback flow (ETA 2 weeks)
- Maya: collect sample tags & schedule enablement once export ships

console-bot: Created product card LW-118 in Product Board (https://productboard.internal/LW-118) assigned to Ben.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll follow up with Lumenware tomorrow and share the enablement invite windows. If we can demo a CSV export before end of next sprint, customer says that materially reduces renewal risk. :relieved:
